description: Take your time , be still , collect data #selflove #selfimprovement #intentionalliving
transcript: When you are distracted, you cannot properly collect information. Data is important because it allows us the capacity to make executive decisions for our lives. It is our role and our responsibility to have both hands on the wheel. In turn, we are able to think further. When we give ourselves the responsibility to collect data for our lives, we stop allowing the external world to dictate the direction that we are going.
